note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

precepts.why: “And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon”: Asia consists of China, Japan, South Korea and North Korea, and Asia has been partaking with Babylon the great, which is the United States of America. “And hast decked thy daughters in whoredom”: the daughters are their corporations, their companies, and the whoredom is business transactions. “Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions”: America has been dishonest in gain. “I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence”: sword is war and pestilence is disease. Look at the Wuhan lab: COVID escaped out of the Wuhan lab, and they published research on monkeypox strains in 2021, and now in 2022 monkeypox is in America, Europe and Asia. And the famine: Shanghai, China’s largest city, 26 million residents in full lockdown and running out of food, 45 cities and 370 million people in lockdown. We think this cannot happen here; it’ll affect a certain amount of cities one month and the next group of cities the next.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

precepts.why: “If thou hadst not always slain my chosen”: you read this and go, when did China ever do this? That’s why we had to do the research. China hides records. “And saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken, Set forth the beauty of thy countenance?” When they killed us they mocked us, because we were the greatest people on earth. Two years ago we played a video of the Asians blaming the Africans over there for the COVID thing. “Therefore shalt thou receive recompence”: recompense means payback. “Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee”.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

precepts.why: “Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.” So don’t feel bad for them. “For since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy”: they danced for joy when they had us as slaves.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

precepts.why: “Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.” The eagle is America; the seal of America is the bald eagle. “Kerioth is taken”: one of their cities, “and the strong holds are surprised”: their military. “The mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs”: they’re going to be frightened to death. America has a bomb they used in Afghanistan named MOAB, the mother of all bombs, the largest air-dropped conventional bomb. Y’all keep feeling bad for these damn Chinese with their wigs and weaves, you sisters; they hate your black guts. A Chinese museum exhibit compared us with animals. In Jamaica and Liberia Chinese men marry black women to get access to own the land, then leave them on the side of the road with babies.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

precepts.why: “Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab”: don’t feel bad for China; they’re going to get what’s coming to them because of what they did to us. “But a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon”: that’s Jordan, “and shall devour the corner of Moab”. “Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth”: destruction to you, China. “For thy sons are taken captives”: prisoners of war. “Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days”. “Thus far is the judgment of Moab”: that’s the judgment of China.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

precepts.why: “I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh”: that was a witch; he wanted to see the Lord, but not nigh, because he’s not an Israelite. “There shall come a Star out of Jacob”: that’s Christ, “and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab”: shall smite the corners of China.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people. He is going to destroy all the lies this white man cast over all people. Like God is white, Jesus is white, the angels are white, the Jews are white.
And the vail that is spread over all nations.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: He will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people. Not just people in America: globally. Wherever you go, whatever church you sit in, whatever continent, country, or island, they all think the white man is God; they think Christ is white. Soon they are going to utter the same sentiment, that the UFOs are demonic fallen angels.
How did he spread this veil over all nations? His media, his network, his communication, because he is the prince of the power of the air.
And how is the Most High going to destroy the covering? He is using us to do that: to cast down the lies and reveal the lies Esau has been telling our people.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: The prophet exalts and praises the Most High for wonderful things and counsels of old that are faithfulness and truth, for He has made of a city a heap and of a defended city a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city, never to be built again. Therefore the strong people shall glorify Him and the city of the terrible nations shall fear Him.

note.label: Isaiah 25: He Will Swallow Up Death in Victory

points: The Most High has been a strength to the poor and to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm and a shadow from the heat when the blast of the terrible ones beats like a storm against the wall. He brings down the noise of strangers as the heat in a dry place, and the branch of the terrible ones is brought low.

note.label: Isaiah 25: He Will Swallow Up Death in Victory

points: In this mountain the Most High of hosts makes for all people a feast of fat things and well refined wines, and destroys the covering cast over all people and the veil spread over all nations. He will swallow up death in victory, wipe away tears from off all faces, and take away the rebuke of His people from all the earth, for the Most High has spoken it.

note.label: Isaiah 25: He Will Swallow Up Death in Victory

points: In that day it shall be said, "Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us," and the people will be glad and rejoice in His salvation, for the hand of the Most High rests in this mountain while Moab is trodden down as straw for the dunghill. The teacher closes by reminding that understanding the word requires keeping the commandments, that the Most High may not give the understanding as soon as it is asked but grants it to those who stay consistent in the readings, that every reading raises new questions because there are deeper levels in books like Isaiah, Ezekiel, and Revelation, and that questions should be taken to the leadership.

note.label: Isaiah 25: He Will Swallow Up Death in Victory

points: We’re going to cover some prophecy today, but don’t think I forgot that we need to change; prophecy means nothing without our changing. “Thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth”: when it says thy counsels, it’s referring to God’s prophecies, his judgments, his testimonies. The Bible is the only true book on the planet.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.” It’s talking about the destruction of Babylon.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “The city of the terrible nations shall fear thee”: the city of the terrible nations shall fear the Most High.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “For thou hast been a strength to the poor”. You got people of other nations saying, well, that’s me because I ain’t got no money; it ain’t talking about that. The poor are the poor in spirit of Israel. Nicodemus, who was wealthy, a Pharisee, was one of those poor Israelites that came to Christ by night; Joseph of Arimathea was rich but poor in spirit. Oprah Winfrey, Tyler Perry: they’re all poor in spirit. Loss of identity, an oppressed nation, slavery: that’s what it’s talking about. “A strength to the needy in his distress”: Christians like to throw all nations in there, but it’s talking about the Israelites coming out of all nations.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers”. “The branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low”: all their generation shall be brought low.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “A feast of wines on the lees”: lees is the dregs, the sediment of wine that settles at the bottom of the vessel if it is not disturbed; the idiom refers to something at ease. It’s talking about fermented wine; we’re going to have fermented wine, not grape juice, “well refined”. “Make unto all people a feast”: don’t forget the thought; he already said he’s going to bring down the strangers, and they shall not pass through the land. All people is Israel coming out from amongst all people. Many scriptures have a double meaning; Isaiah 34 also talks about the Lord having a sacrifice in the land.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “And he will destroy in this mountain”: the only thing that can break the spell of witchcraft is the word of God, and this kingdom is filled with witchcraft, whether you call it science or whatever; Christianity is a spell on people. “The face of the covering cast over all people”: a covering of lies, cast over everybody on the planet Earth, “and the vail that is spread over all nations.”

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces”. We cry now at the oppression we suffer and the inhumane treatment of our people from sun up to sun down; he said he’s going to wipe away all tears from our eyes. “And the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth”: the rebuke of his people is Deuteronomy 28:15-68, the curses of slavery, oppression and loss of identity. He’s going to remove that from all of us.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us”: not man, he will save us. When we see that sign of the Son of man in heaven we’re going to say this is the day we’ve been waiting for. “We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.” A lot of times we want the Lord to come now. If you had any wisdom you would know it’s good the Lord don’t come yet; probably three fourths of us listening ain’t really ready yet.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him”. In case you don’t know who Moab is, Moab is the Chinese. China will not be the next world superpower; China is going to be destroyed. “Even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill”: the dunghill is a pile of s-h-i-t. You got the Kemetic community and these Moors talking about black people as the Moabites; stop listening to them.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

points: “And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.” This is talking about China.
